def solve(gin):
    h,w=len(gin),len(gin[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in gin]
    bg=0
    # determine bg from most common
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in gin for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    sixes=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if gin[r][c]==6]
    def dirvec(p):
        dr=1 if p[0]>h//2 else -1; dc=1 if p[1]>w//2 else -1
        return dr,dc
    for r,c in sixes:
        dr,dc=dirvec((r,c))
        rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
        while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and gin[rr][cc]==bg:
            out[rr][cc]=3
            rr+=dr; cc+=dc
    return out
